Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a French-speaking Software Tester to support the quality assurance of digital applications developed in a Java-based environment within the insurance industry. The role involves validating application functionality against business requirements, identifying defects and collaborating with developers and business stakeholders to ensure software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
 What you will do: 
Analyse business requirements and user stories to define test scenarios and test cases. 
Perform software testing to validate application functionality and compliance with business requirements. 
Identify, document and track defects, collaborating with developers to ensure timely resolution. 
Execute regression and integration tests and support other testing activities as required. 
Maintain test documentation and communicate testing results and potential risks.
Collaborate with developers, Product Owners and business stakeholders within an Agile/Scrum environment. 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.
 What you must have: 
2–4 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance. 
Good knowledge of software testing principles, test case design, test execution and defect management. 
Experience with test management and defect tracking tools, such as Jira, Xray or Zephyr. 
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycles.
Experience with web applications; exposure to Java-based applications is an advantage. 
Familiarity with test automation concepts is an advantage. 
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and problem-solving abilities. 
Good communication and collaboration skills. 
Fluent French (C1/C2), mandatory, and good professional English.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and commited people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
